as_told.title: Mario Woods abducted at Ellsworth AFB, then had his teeth checked
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

plain: In the 1960s, a man named Mario Woods, who guarded nuclear missiles at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, is said to have been taken by aliens and then examined at the base hospital. A researcher named Robert Hastings, who studies UFO reports around nuclear bases, passes on what Woods told him. According to Hastings, the doctor found a round wound or dent with a small dimple in the centre, on Woods's forehead and on his ankle. Michels tells it too, also from Woods's account, and adds that Woods held a Q clearance, a high security clearance for nuclear work, and guarded ICBMs, long-range nuclear missiles. In Michels's version a doctor checked Woods's teeth, and he says nothing of the wounds. If true, it would mean something was taking a close interest in the men who guard America's nuclear weapons.
